headline: Indonesia Launches Interest-Free Financing Scheme for Micro Enterprises
summary: Indonesia's Coordinating Ministry for Community Empowerment rolled out the 'Perintis Berdaya' pilot program to provide interest-free commercial financing for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs).
why: Micro and small businesses generate over 60% of Indonesia's GDP, serving as a primary driver of employment in Southeast Asia's largest economy.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Interest-free credit access supports working capital and business expansion for small Indonesian firms.
